components.css: .ds-stem { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: min(58%, 220px); min-width: 160px; height: 4.5rem; border: 2px solid #e23a2e; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c92218, #a81610); color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 0 #8e1610, 0 18px 28px rgba(140, 30, 20, 0.32); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stem:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-stem:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f6b4a; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-stem:active { transform: translateY(8px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #8e1610, 0 8px 16px rgba(140, 30, 20, 0.28); } .ds-stem-label { pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Hold Stem Hover

components.name: Egg Timer Dial
components.description: CSS-native chrome rim + cream enamel face — the circular silhouette that owns the viewport.
components.html:
Get to 1 second

0.000
components.css: .ds-timer { --dial-size: min(78vw, 320px); position: relative; width: var(--dial-size); height: var(--dial-size); display: grid; place-items: center; filter: drop-shadow(0 28px 48px rgba(40, 50, 40, 0.28)); } .ds-timer__rim { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #c4cbcf, #7f878c 45%, #b8c0c4); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45), inset 0 -3px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } .ds-timer__face { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: calc(100% - 28px); height: calc(100% - 28px); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 42% 32%, #fffaf2, #f0e6d8 55%, #e2d4c4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 10px #efe6da, inset 0 0 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-timer__ticks { position: absolute; inset: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(from -0.5deg, #2a2e2c 0 1deg, transparent 1deg 6deg); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 16px), #000 calc(100% - 16px)); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 16px), #000 calc(100% - 16px)); opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } .ds-timer__title { position: absolute; top: 18%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); margin: 0; font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; color: #2a2e2c; text-align: center; } .ds-timer__hand { position: absolute; top: 14%; left: 50%; width: 6px; height: 33%; margin-left: -3px; border-radius: 3px; background: #e23a2e; transform-origin: 50% 100%; opacity: 0.55; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(255 250 242 / 0.45); } .ds-timer__hand::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -7px; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: -8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e23a2e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fffaf2; } .ds-timer__readout { position: relative; z-index: 3; margin: 0; font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #2a2e2c; }

narrative.overview:
The product is one physical kitchen timer sitting on a soft sage countertop. The viewport is that object: chrome rim, cream enamel face, tomato-red second hand, and a tomato stem you press. Hold winds time; release freezes the dial. Exact 1.000 earns confetti. Everything else is atmosphere around a single circular silhouette.

Personality is playful restraint — enamel and chrome, not neon UI chrome. Density is sparse: title, tabular readout, hand, stem, one hint. The system refuses the centered-title-plus-blue-button microgame template and refuses cards, dashboards, and multi-control layouts.
keyCharacteristics: One circular dial owns the viewport; no cards or side panels
Soft sage ground, cream enamel face, tomato stem/hand, ink numerals
Display face Bricolage Grotesque; UI Figtree
CSS-native materials only (gradients, masks, inset chrome) — no shipping illustration rasters
Stem is the sole control; hard emboss offset lives only on that control

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Tomato family is reserved for hand, stem, and win feedback. Never recolor ground, enamel, or chrome with tomato fills.

rules.name: The Enamel Face Rule
rules.body: Face type and ticks stay Ink on cream enamel. Win may deepen readout/result to Tomato Deep; idle never paints the face tomato.

rules.name: The Face Type Rule
rules.body: Only Bricolage Grotesque sits on the enamel (title + readout). Figtree never becomes face display type.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: The readout always uses tabular numerals so digits do not jitter while winding.

rules.name: The One Silhouette Rule
rules.body: The first viewport is the circular timer plus stem and hint. No cards, stats strips, side panels, or second CTAs.

rules.name: The Stem-Only Emboss Rule
rules.body: Hard offset shadow is native to the tomato stem as a physical wind button. Do not apply hard offset shelves to the dial, hint, or future surfaces.

rules.name: The Soft Dial Rule
rules.body: The circular mass lifts with a soft drop-shadow and inset chrome, never a card box-shadow or floating panel.

rules.name: The Circle Owns the Page Rule
rules.body: New UI that is not the stem must defer to the circular dial silhouette; rectangular cards and inset media frames are out of world.

dos: Do keep one circular timer as the first-viewport composition (dial + stem + hint).
Do use Tomato only for hand, stem, holding halo, and win feedback.
Do set face display type in Bricolage Grotesque with tabular numerals on the readout.
Do build materials with CSS gradients, masks, and inset chrome — no shipping illustration rasters for the dial.
Do reserve hard emboss offset for the stem control.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by removing timer/stem/readout motion.
donts: Don't ship a centered-title-plus-blue-button microgame layout.
Don't introduce cards, dashboards, icon rows, or secondary CTAs.
Don't put Figtree on the enamel as display type, or Bricolage on the stem label.
Don't flood the sage ground with tomato fills or purple/glow UI tropes.
Don't treat review screenshots under .impeccable/review/ as shipping brand assets.
